g.title: j2269922955
g.text: It seems you have managed to go quite awry with both Marie and the Orokin. I... am impressed.

g.title: j1525299158
g.text: It seems you have managed to go quite awry with Marie. How have you managed that?

g.title: j1627131545
g.text: It seems you have managed to go quite awry with the Orokin. I am not precisely shocked.

g.title: j249349989
g.text: You have my pledge to help with the butler, but something has gone awry with the plan, it seems.

g.title: j6300323
g.text: Mon miracle, I feel as though I have been absent-minded. I must apologize.

g.title: j3622356022
g.text: My friend, I feel as though I have been absent-minded. I must apologize.

g.title: j3803632392
g.text: Please don't start. I don't need the guilt from the priest, thank you.

g.title: j1096336534
g.text: I actually think if one of my friend's rats were asleep on the keys and generated random words, I would have done better.

g.title: j1781238906
g.text: She misunderstood what I was saying.

g.title: j2664742348
g.text: I... said things I shouldn't. just wish I could have done better by her. I think I did a poor job of portraying my intentions.

g.title: j2428033998
g.text: Things between he and I have been... complicated and confusing.

g.title: j206871547
g.text: You seek my assistance with the butler, do you not?

g.title: j2456208017
g.text: Yes, well. I think I am coming to understand how this happened.

g.title: j945422698
g.text: If you could have just heard me laugh. I am not judging you, I honestly sympathize more than you might know. And it is for that reason I will help you.

g.title: j2712586756
g.text: I understand your frustration, believe me.

g.title: j4214499775
g.text: It seems the devil is... dragging his feet. But without Marie, you will not go far, either.

g.title: j1767952405
g.text: You have the Orokin's pledge of support, but not Marie's. A matter easy enough to solve. But I must ask, how have you managed it?

g.title: j2766562974
g.text: It seems you have the help of Marie, but not Roathe? Unsurprising.

g.title: j3719088087
g.text: It seems the devil is... dragging his feet.

g.title: j98897530
g.text: Am I the only one you have managed to convince? I am... impressed.

g.title: j2164537549
g.text: Marie is the sister of my soul, and the devil owes me a favor. I will not speak of what it is from, it is a secret I intend to take to my grave, so do not bother asking over what it was about.

g.title: j3101557858
g.text: Or a perfectly fine job of it, by the sound of things.

g.title: j2449137888
g.text: I will speak to her. I will see what I can do.

g.title: j2684700776
g.text: I will speak to him. He... owes me a favor.

g.title: j3803393853
g.text: Yet here we are, all the same.

g.title: j4258157634
g.text: A matter easy enough to rectify, if you will allow me to do so?

g.title: j2803723239
g.text: My thoughts tend to veer into strange places, especially as of late. Of course, I will help.

g.title: j2363556033
g.text: Needless to say, will you allow me to... solve this problem for you?

g.title: j685310494
g.text: Do not ask what it is from. It goes with me to my grave.

g.title: j4041251897
g.text: I would have recommended speaking with a priest, but... here you are.

g.title: j1988718110
g.text: Um... no. I'd rather do it on my own, thanks.

g.title: j3198121625
g.text: Of course. What else is family for?

g.title: j720194540
g.text: In the meanwhile, I will do what I can to remedy the situation from here.

g.title: j2251697642
g.text: It seems you have garnered the help of both the others, and I am the last bastion. Now I am truly embarrassed. Let us to work, then.

g.title: j699921049
g.text: It seems you have the help of Roathe, but not Marie?

g.title: j1744209269
g.text: Yes, well. What are "families" for, I suppose...

g.title: j1704292118
g.text: Solspeed, and may Lua guide you. You will need it.
